# What this document is for

Two indexes are declared, and the marker for the second is written before the
marker for the first. A back-end that keeps one index — a LaTeX or PDF render,
or an HTML book — builds only the first, and the place the author asked for it
is their own marker for it. That marker stands second here, which is the shape
that used to put the one index under the other marker's heading and then
report the author's own marker as a second marker for an index they wrote one
marker for.

One term files in each: [Alpha]{.index} and
[Babbage]{.index index="authors"}.
